name: Maya, the cautious student
text: I'm 20 with $1,500 saved and can add $100 a month. I want a car in 3 years and I don't want to lose much.

name: Arjun, the first-job saver
text: I have $9,000 in savings and can invest $500 a month for a house deposit in 6 years. I like tech, no oil companies.

name: Daniel, the helping parent
text: Teaching my 16-year-old: $2,000 now, $150 a month, for 10 years. Keep it simple, clean energy if possible.
